transcripts.text: The wetland is quite varied too. The original farmland was dug up around 40 years ago to extract gravel. transcripts.text: It sounds great. So what about the practical side of it? How much does it cost for a full day visit? We would expect to bring between 30 and 40 children.

transcripts.text: Last month, 25 members of the association from Stanthorpe spent a weekend in Malat. Our hosts had arranged a great programme. We learned how cheese is produced in the region and had the chance to taste the products.

The theme park trip had to be canceled but we all had a great time on the final boat trip down the river, that was the real highlight. transcripts.text: But how about your project on reusing waste food? You were looking at bread, weren't you?

transcripts.text: Hmm, did the article mention ghost kitchens used to produce takeaway food?
No, what are they?
